    var cat = [g('$.category1_name'), g('$.category2_name')].filter(uniq).join(' · ');
    var tags = g('$.book_tag_list[*].title').split(/\s*\n\s*/).filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var score = g('$.attribute.score');
    var scoreT = g('$.attribute.score_title');
    var info = g('$.attribute.reading_info_list[*]').split(/\s*\n\s*/);
    var hot = [];
    if (info[0]) hot.push(info[0] + (info[1] ? '（' + info[1].split('・').pop() + '）' : ''));
    if (info[2]) hot.push(info[2] + '人在读');

    var desc = g('$.intro')
        .replace(/\r/g, '')
        .replace(/^[\s\u3000]+/, '')
        .replace(/[ \t\u3000]*\n[\s\u3000]*/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n/g, '\n\u3000\u3000');

    var L = [];
    var add = function (icon, label, val) {
        if (val) L.push('\u3000\u3000' + icon + ' ' + label + '：' + val);
    };
    add('📕', '书名', g('$.title'));
    add('👤', '作者', g('$.author'));
    add('🗂️', '分类', cat);
    add('📊', '字数', state);
    add('🔖', '标签', tags);
    add('⭐', '评分', score ? score + (scoreT ? '（' + scoreT + '）' : '') : '');
    add('🔥', '人气', hot.join(' · '));
    add('🕐', '更新', time);
    add('📖', '最新', g('$.latest_chapter_title'));
    if (desc) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📜 简介：');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000' + desc);
    }
    var src = g('$.source');
    if (src) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📍 版权来源：' + src);
    }
    return L.join('\n');
})()

ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 从 baseUrl 中提取书籍 ID 和章节 ID
let aid = baseUrl.match(/book(?:s)?\/(\d+)/)[1];
let cid = baseUrl.match(/\/(\d+)\.html/)[1];

// 直接发起请求获取包含校验变量的脚本内容并存储在 tokenScript 变量中
let tokenScript = java.ajax(`https://www.deqixs.co/scripts/chapter.js.php?aid=${aid}&cid=${cid}&referrer=${baseUrl}`);

// 从返回的脚本内容中通过正则提取所需的校验参数
let token = tokenScript.match(/chapterToken\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/)[1];
let timestamp = tokenScript.match(/timestamp\s*=\s*(\d+)/)[1];
let nonce = tokenScript.match(/nonce\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/)[1];

// 构造用于最终正文接口请求的参数字符串
let params = `aid=${aid}&cid=${cid}&token=${token}&timestamp=${timestamp}&nonce=${nonce}`;

// 定义包含编码、来源页面和 User-Agent 的请求配置对象
let options = {
    "charset": "gbk",
    "headers": {
        "Referer": baseUrl,
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Android 7) Mobile",
        "X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest"
    }
};

// 发起最终的异步请求并解析返回的 JSON 数据从中提取正文
result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://www.deqixs.co/modules/article/ajax2.php?${params},${JSON.stringify(options)}`)).data.content;
</js>
ruleContent.replaceRegex:
<js>
// 转义标题变量中的特殊字符，确保正则安全
let safeTitle = title.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');

// 根据标题长度动态匹配并清理正文中的重复标题行
if (title.length < 5) {
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${safeTitle}\\s*\\n`, "i"), "");
} else {
    let shortTitle = safeTitle.substr(0, Math.floor(safeTitle.length * 2 / 3));
    result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*${shortTitle}.*\\n`, "i"), "");
}

// 匹配并移除以“第X章”开头的特征行，防止章节名残留
result = result.replace(new RegExp(`^\\s*第\\S+?章.{0,${title.length}}\\n`, "i"), "");

// 清理文末各种括号格式的“本章完”字样
result = result.replace(/\s*[（|(]本章完[)|）]\s*/g, "");

// 批量清理官方广告及推广干扰语
let officialRules = [/更新不易.+?看最新章节！/g, /更新不易.+?看最新无错章节！/g, /更新不易.+?最新小说章节！/g, /速读谷/g, /速.读.谷/g, /速 读 谷/g, /本章节未完.+?请订阅/g];
officialRules.forEach(rule => result = result.replace(rule, ""));

result;
</js>

<js>
function styles(so) {
    var today = new Date();
    var dateT = today.getFullYear()
        + '-'
        + (today.getMonth() + 1)
        + '-'
        + today.getDate()
        + '_discover_tabs';

    var url = Api('/api/discover/tabs');
    var res = null;
    var cacheData = '';
    var sourceItem = null;
    var result = [];
    var tab;
    var count = 0;
    var i;
    var u;

    try {
        cacheData = cache.get(dateT)+"1";

        if (cacheData) {
            try {
                res = JSON.parse(cacheData);
            } catch (e) {
                res = null;
            }
        }

        if (!res) {
            res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url));

            if (res && res.code == 0) {
                cache.put(dateT, JSON.stringify(res));
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        return [{
            title: '数据加载失败，请刷新后重试',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    if (!res || res.code != 0 || !res.data || !res.data.sources) {
        return [{
            title: '请先登陆，登陆后刷新发现页即可',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < res.data.sources.length; i++) {
        if (res.data.sources[i] && res.data.sources[i].name == so) {
            sourceItem = res.data.sources[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!sourceItem || !sourceItem.tabs || sourceItem.tabs.length == 0) {
        return [{
            title: '暂无' + (so || '') + '发现内容',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < sourceItem.tabs.length; i++) {
        tab = sourceItem.tabs[i];

        if (!tab) {
            continue;
        }

        if (tab.section) {
            if (count > 0) {
                while (count < 3) {
                    result.push({
                        title: '--',
                        url: '',
                        style: {
                            layout_flexGrow: 1,
                            layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                        }
                    });
                    count++;
                }
            }

            result.push({
                title: tab.title || '',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            });

            count = 0;
            continue;
        }

        u = '/api/discover/content?source='
            + encodeURIComponent(sourceItem.source || '')
            + '&tab='
            + encodeURIComponent(tab.key || '')
            + '&page={{page}}&page_size=12';

        result.push({
            title: tab.title || '',
            url: Api(u),
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
            }
        });

        count++;

        if (count >= 3) {
            count = 0;
        }
    }

    if (count > 0) {
        while (count < 3) {
            result.push({
                title: '--',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                }
            });

            count++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

var so = cache.get('sources') || '起点小说';

var s = [
    create(
        "请选择平台",
        ["番茄小说", "七猫小说", "书旗小说", "塔读小说","红烛故事","西瓜小说","轻小说","星星短剧","依依短剧","起点小说"],
        so,
        "sources",
        1
    )
];



JSON.stringify(s.concat(styles(so)), null, 2);
</js>

        }
    }
}</js>

<js>
var url = source.key
//处理强制登录
var nn = String(cookie.getCookie(url));
var coks = nn.split('; '); 
ckk = coks.filter(item => !item 
.startsWith("lf_reader_num")).join('; ');
cookie.setCookie(url,ckk);

//自动处理验证
let html = src;

function txt(sr) {
    let text;
    if (src.includes("滑动验证")) {
        let headers = {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 9) Mobile Safari/537.36",
            "Referer": baseUrl
        };
        try {
            let s = src.match(/src=\"(\/huadong[^"]+)/)[1];
            let sr = java.get(url + s, headers).body()
            eval(sr.match(/(key=\".+?,value=\"[^;]+?\;)/)[1]);
            let va = getval(value);
            let codeul = url + sr.match(/([^"]+yanzheng_huadong\.php[^"]+)/)[1] + `${key}&value=${va}`;
            let ck = java.get(codeul, headers);
            java.log("验证Cookie：" + JSON.stringify(ck.cookies()));
            java.toast("检测到验证,尝试自动处理……");
            let tx = java.ajax(baseUrl);
            html = tx;
            text = java.getString('#chapterContent@html', tx);
        } catch (error) {
            java.log(error);
            text = "自动验证失败，请重试!";
        }
    } else {
        text = java.getString('#chapterContent@html', src);
    }
    return text;
}

let text = txt(html);

//处理重新获取文本时可能会出现的错误。
let retryCount = 0;
const maxRetries = 3;
let result;
while (retryCount < maxRetries) {
    if (text != false && text !== "") {
        result = text;
        break;
    } else {
        retryCount++;
        text = txt(html);
        Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(400);
        java.toast(`未获取到文本，正在重试...（当前第${retryCount}次重试）`);
    }
}

if (retryCount === maxRetries) {
    result = "重试三次仍然未获取到文本，请检查网络状况。"
}
result;
</js>

<js>
//md5加密开始
var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}
var F = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & y) | ((~x) & z)
}
var G = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & z) | (y & (~z))
}
var H = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x ^ y ^ z)
}
var I = function(x, y, z) {
    return (y ^ (x | (~z)))
}
var FF = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(F(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var GG = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(G(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var HH = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(H(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var II = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(I(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)
};
var convertToWordArray = function(string) {
    var lWordCount;
    var lMessageLength = string.length;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempOne = lMessageLength + 8;
    var lNumberOfWordsTempTwo = (lNumberOfWordsTempOne - (lNumberOfWordsTempOne % 64)) / 64;
    var lNumberOfWords = (lNumberOfWordsTempTwo + 1) * 16;
    var lWordArray = Array(lNumberOfWords - 1);
    var lBytePosition = 0;
    var lByteCount = 0;
    while (lByteCount < lMessageLength) {
        lWordCount = (lByteCount - (lByteCount % 4)) / 4;
        lBytePosition = (lByteCount % 4) * 8;
        lWordArray[lWordCount] = (lWordArray[lWordCount] | (string.charCodeAt(lByteCount) << lBytePosition));
        lByteCount++
    }
    lWordCount = (lByteCount - (lByteCount % 4)) / 4;
    lBytePosition = (lByteCount % 4) * 8;
    lWordArray[lWordCount] = lWordArray[lWordCount] | (0x80 << lBytePosition);
    lWordArray[lNumberOfWords - 2] = lMessageLength << 3;
    lWordArray[lNumberOfWords - 1] = lMessageLength >>> 29;
    return lWordArray
};
var wordToHex = function(lValue) {
    var WordToHexValue = "",
    WordToHexValueTemp = "",
    lByte, lCount;
    for (lCount = 0; lCount <= 3; lCount++) {
        lByte = (lValue >>> (lCount * 8)) & 255;
        WordToHexValueTemp = "0" + lByte.toString(16);
        WordToHexValue = WordToHexValue + WordToHexValueTemp.substr(WordToHexValueTemp.length - 2, 2)
    }
    return WordToHexValue
};
var uTF8Encode = function(string) {
    string = string.replace(/\x0d\x0a/g, "\x0a");
    var output = "";
    for (var n = 0; n < string.length; n++) {
        var c = string.charCodeAt(n);
        if (c < 128) {

<js>
  function login() {
    const user = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号"))
    const pw = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码"))
    let sign = java.md5Encode(`isDevice=Android&password=${pw}&phone=${user}&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    let data = JSON.stringify({
      isDevice: "Android",
      password: pw,
      phone: user,
      regDevice: "2",
      sign: sign
    })
    let op = JSON.stringify({
      method: "POST",
      body: data
    })
    let res = java.ajax(`https://api.shaoniandream.com/Login/login,${op}`)
    let $ = JSON.parse(res)
    if($.status != 1) java.toast($.msg)
    java.put("uid",$.data.id)
    source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify({
      logintoken: $.data.logintoken
    }))
  }
</js>

      let op = JSON.stringify({
        method: "POST",

      })
      array.push({
        name: chapter.title,

  })

}

}

} else {

}

function getText(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().text() : "";
}

function getHref(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().attr("href") : "";
}

function getSrc(selector, context) {
    var elements = context ? context.select(selector) : document.select(selector);
    return elements.size() > 0 ? elements.first().attr("src") : "";
}

function generateJsonList() {
    var jsonList = [];
    var uls = document.select(".mySearch ul").not(".pagination"); 

    uls.forEach(function(ul) {
        var prevDiv = ul.previousElementSibling(); 
        var imgSrc = prevDiv ? getSrc("img", prevDiv) : ""; 

        var item = {
            "img": imgSrc,
            "name": getText("li:eq(0) a.b", ul),
            "author": getText("li:eq(2)", ul),
            "wordcount": getText("li:eq(3)", ul),
            "lastchaptr": getText("li:eq(1) a", ul),
            "kind": getText("li:eq(4)", ul)+","+getText("li:eq(5)", ul),
            "url": getHref("li:eq(0) a.b", ul)
        };
        jsonList.push(item);
    });

    return jsonList;
}

    "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
  };
}
function encBody(text, sk, iv){
  try {
    return java.createSymmetricCrypto("aes/cbc/pkcs7padding", java.strToBytes(sk), java.strToBytes(iv)).encryptBase64(text);
  } catch(e) {}
  try {
    var key = Packages.javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(java.strToBytes(sk), "AES");
    var ivi = Packages.javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(java.strToBytes(iv));
    var ci = Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
    ci.init(Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key, ivi);
    return Packages.java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(ci.doFinal(java.strToBytes(text)));
  } catch(e) { return ""; }
}
function ajaxPost(url, body){
  // 与参考版一致：普通 java.ajax，不加特殊请求头（手机UA即可，被WAF拦会自动回退）
  try {
    return String(java.ajax(url + ',' + JSON.stringify({method: 'POST', body: body})) || '');
  } catch(e) { return ''; }
}

// ===== 第1页章节：兼容 人人书城/爱书库(chapListBody) 与 书友社(chapterList) =====
var hrefs = [], names = [];
try { hrefs = java.getStringList('class.chapListBody@li@a@href') || []; } catch(e) {}
try { names = java.getStringList('class.chapListBody@li@a@text') || []; } catch(e) {}
if(hrefs.length === 0){
  try { hrefs = java.getStringList('class.chapterList@class.list@li@div.name@a@href') || []; } catch(e) {}
  try { names = java.getStringList('class.chapterList@class.list@li@div.name@a@text') || []; } catch(e) {}
}
var out = [];
for(var i = 0; i < hrefs.length; i++){
  var u = absUrl(hrefs[i]);
  out.push({name: names[i] || '', url: u, order: numOf(u)});
}

// ===== 解析 id / 分页数 / AES密钥 =====
var id = '';
try {
  var mid = String(baseUrl || '').match(/\/(?:chapter|book)\/([^\/.?]+?)(?:-\d+)?\.html/);
  if(mid) id = mid[1];
} catch(e) {}
var pageCount = 0;
try {
  var opts = java.getElements('[data-aid="' + id + '"]@option') || [];
  if(opts.length === 0) opts = java.getElements('[data-aid="' + id + '"]@li') || [];
  pageCount = opts.length;
} catch(e) {}
var secretKey = '', ivKey = '';
try {
  var src = String(result || '');
  var mjs = src.match(/<script[^>]*src="([^"]*\/([A-Za-z0-9]{32,})\.js)"[^>]*>/);
  if(mjs){
    var jsTxt = String(java.ajax(absUrl(mjs[1])) || '');
    var mk = jsTxt.match(/AESCrypt\('([^']+)'\)/);
    var mik = jsTxt.match(/parse\('([^']+)'\)/);
    if(mk) secretKey = mk[1];
    if(mik) ivKey = mik[1];
  }
} catch(e) {}

// ===== 拉取其余页（java.post + Edge头） =====
var fetched = false;
if(id && pageCount > 1 && secretKey && ivKey){
  try {
    var baseHost = String(baseUrl || '').match(/^(https?:\/\/[^\/]+)/);
    baseHost = baseHost ? baseHost[1] : '';
    for(var p = 2; p <= pageCount; p++){
      try {
        var body = JSON.stringify({id: id, page: p});
        var enc = encBody(body, secretKey, ivKey);
        if(!enc) break;
        var resp = ajaxPost(baseHost + '/index.php?action=loadChapterPage', 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(enc));
        var obj = JSON.parse(resp);
        if(obj && obj.code === 0 && obj.data && obj.data.length){
          for(var j = 0; j < obj.data.length; j++){
            var it = obj.data[j];
            var u2 = absUrl(it.chapterurl || '');
            out.push({name: it.chaptername || '', url: u2, order: parseInt(it.chapterorder, 10) || numOf(u2) || 0});
          }
          fetched = true;
        } else { break; }
      } catch(e) { break; }
      try { Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(800 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 500)); } catch(e) {}
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ===== 去重 + 升序 =====
var seen = {}, list = [];
for(var i = 0; i < out.length; i++){
  var k = out[i].order || out[i].url;
  if(seen[k]) continue;
  seen[k] = 1;
  list.push(out[i]);
}
list.sort(function(a, b){ return (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0); });

// ===== 分页失败：用总章数占位补齐（不重复） =====
if(!fetched && id && list.length > 0){
  try {
    var bu = (typeof book !== 'undefined' && book && book.bookUrl) ? book.bookUrl : absUrl('/book/' + id + '.html');
    var detail = String(java.ajax(bu) || '');
    var mt = detail.match(/og:novel:latest_chapter_name"\s+content="第(\d+)章/);
    if(!mt) mt = detail.match(/\((\d+)章节\)/);
    var total = mt ? parseInt(mt[1], 10) : 0;
    var have = {};
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){ have[list[i].order] = 1; }
    for(var n = 1; n <= total; n++){
      if(!have[n]){
        list.push({name: '第' + n + '章', url: absUrl('/book/' + id + '-' + n + '.html'), order: n});
      }
    }
    list.sort(function(a, b){ return (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0); });
  } catch(e) {}
}

var res = [];
for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
  res.push(JSON.stringify({name: list[i].name, url: list[i].url, order: list[i].order}));
}
if(res.length === 0 && id){
  res.push(JSON.stringify({name: '第1章', url: absUrl('/book/' + id + '-1.html'), order: 1}));
}
res;
</js>
